name: Company Registry
description: Machine-readable US company registry. Search companies by service keyword and city; read structured company facts. Paid placements are labeled sponsored.

skills.name: Search companies by keyword
skills.description: Service + optional US city, e.g. 'roofing minneapolis'. Sponsored results flagged.

skills.name: Keyword market data
skills.description: Search volume, local search estimate, CPC benchmark, competition, registry competitors and sponsored-spot starting bid for a keyword. Sourced; estimates labeled.
